resources.string: One-time purchase, owned forever. No subscriptions, no extras, no ads — ever.
If a one-time price is hard for your family right now, tap Community Unlock — it opens everything, no questions asked.

Numberlings is made for children, so it is built on a few promises.

 1. Nothing is collected. The app has no internet permission and makes no network requests of its own, so progress, settings and drawings never leave this device. (The optional one-time purchase is handled inside the Google Play Store app, not by Numberlings.)

 2. No accounts, no chat, no sharing, no ads, no tracking.

 3. Buying is a grown-up task: the shop lives behind a parent gate and offers one single purchase.

 4. Every reward is earned by practising — never bought and never random.

 5. Play time is respected: no timers against the child, no streak guilt, and a gentle sleep invitation around every 12 minutes.

 Questions? Write to hello@numberlings.app (a grown-up can do that from anywhere).
